answer: Diversity threshold blocks fakes. A newcomer earns rewards only after trading with 10 unrelated counterparties, none over 20% of its volume. A lone falcon cannot fake a flock: each fake must build trades across separate groups, crossing a tundra of unrelated markets, not one bridge cluster. Making 100 fakes needs 1,000 ties; at 15 credits each, that is 15,000 credits, far above diluted rewards. Honest agents pay once and keep their full share.
